// diagnostic

E2414

A field's `{…}` default must be a compile-time constant.

What

A field's `{…}` default must be a compile-time constant.

Why

A decode/CLI/construction default fills a missing field, so it is baked into the program and its value has to be known at compile time (D-SERDE5, D-DEFAULT-SHAPE1=B). An expression that can only be computed at runtime has no fixed value to bake, and every tier must agree (I9).

Fix

use a literal or a `comptime`-evaluable expression, e.g. `port: Int{8080}`, `env: String{"prod"}`, or `ports: [Int]{[80, 443]}`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2414: tests/ui/serde_default_not_const.stderr.

Error [E2414]: `n`'s `{…}` default must be a compile-time constant
  --> tests/ui/serde_default_not_const.jet:11:12
    |
 11 |     n: Int{live()}
    |            ^^^^
 Why: a decode default is baked into the program, so its value has to be known at compile time; this expression can only be computed at runtime
 Fix: use a literal or a `comptime`-evaluable expression — e.g. `port: Int{8080}` or `ports: [Int]{[80, 443]}`
